BacktestTimestamp.description: UTC with Z and at most microsecond precision; local offsets and naive values are rejected.

BacktestDecimal.description: Exact finite Decimal string; no exponent, whitespace or JSON number. Precision 38, ROUND_HALF_EVEN; USD scale 8 and return scale 12. Semantic precision and rounding are validated by the domain.

BacktestStartCash.description: Positive USD cash at most 1000000000, at most 8 fractional digits.

BacktestSmaParameters.description: Semantic validation additionally requires fast < slow before job creation.

BacktestFold.description: Half-open UTC windows. Domain validation requires trainingStart < trainingEnd <= testStart < testEnd, chronologically ordered disjoint tests and at most 366 calendar days including warm-up.

BacktestRequest.description: REQ-BKT-001/006/007; T-BKT-002/011/014. Only catalog instrument IDs resolving to SPY or QQQ. Server binds every manifest reference. Semantic window and SMA ordering checks run before persistence. REQ-RRB-001/004/006/012; T-RRB-002/008/010/011/020. Omitted or explicit STRICT_PIT preserves legacy hash/idempotency identity. Only retrospective starts accept and require policy plus exact assessment ID/hash; normalized protocol and current trust are revalidated before execution.

barStart.description: UTC with Z and at most microsecond precision; local offsets and naive values are rejected.

BacktestManifest.description: Immutable server-bound input manifest. Revision arrays are sorted by natural identity/revisionId; decisions by knowledgeAt and outcomes by bar identity/cutoff. Run UUID and elapsed runtime excluded from hashes. A manifest may be unavailable until dataset binding completes.

completedAt.description: UTC with Z and at most microsecond precision; local offsets and naive values are rejected.

BacktestRun.description: Durable receipt returned on initial and identical replayed requests. BLOCKED/FAILED may retain completed fold references; never a run-wide return. REQ-RRB-006; T-RRB-008/010. Additive context fields are optional for legacy schema compatibility; servers emit all fields for every run, projecting legacy rows as STRICT_PIT. Current warnings are separate from immutable experiment identity.

BacktestRunDetail.description: REQ-RRB-006; T-RRB-008/010. Additive context fields are optional for legacy schema compatibility; servers emit all fields for every run, projecting legacy rows as STRICT_PIT. Current warnings are separate from immutable experiment identity.

BacktestCursor.description: Opaque HMAC-signed keyset token, bound to resource kind, runId, result type, filters and immutable list snapshot. Malformed/signature-invalid token => 400 CURSOR_INVALID; changed context/snapshot => 409 SNAPSHOT_CONFLICT. Never client-built. Example tokens illustrate syntax only, not valid signatures.

BacktestProblem.description: Whitelist-only sanitized problem; no provider text, SQL, stack, credentials or arbitrary detail.

BacktestSnapshotReference.description: Immutable complete-commit dataset boundary; later commits remain excluded even when their timestamps are earlier.

BacktestAssessmentRequest.description: REQ-RRB-001/004/008/012; T-RRB-002/008/011/013/020. Closed retrospective preview protocol; bounded local snapshot inspection only, without simulation. Same chronological, instrument, strategy and Decimal bounds as BacktestRequest.

BacktestReportCursor.description: Opaque signed cursor bound to reportId, immutable reportHash/version, section and category/fold filters. Invalid signature => 400 CURSOR_INVALID; changed report/filter/version => 409 SNAPSHOT_CONFLICT. Example tokens demonstrate syntax only.

BacktestReliabilityBarCounts.description: Counts cover the explicit fold section. Expected/missing remain null when calendar denominator is unknown; zero never represents unknown.

BacktestRetrospectiveRevision.description: Actual revision evidence preserved without timestamp rewriting. Unknown genuine first observation/provider publication is null. Historical market bounds are separate from these current observations.

BacktestRetrospectiveOutcomeInput.description: Outcome-only price evidence, isolated from strategy inputs. Simulated market cutoff asserts no historical local receipt time.

BacktestLicenseReceipt.description: Immutable actual snapshot receipt from the narrow current license port. CONFIRMED is a declaration, not verified personal rights; source BLOCKED maps to DENIED.

BacktestRetrospectiveManifest.description: REQ-RRB-002/003/004; T-RRB-003/004/005/006/007/008. Complete immutable retrospective experiment-v1 input binding, distinct from byte-identical legacy Strict manifests. request is the normalized preview protocol excluding receipt IDs/hash; no circular assessment identity. SHA256 uses canonical Decimal/UTC serialization. Runtime IDs/timings and current warnings are excluded. All revisions are fingerprint-bound, never latest; maximum 100000 combined revision/metadata rows and 12 MiB publication are additionally checked semantically.

BacktestReliabilityMethods.description: Binds the complete manifest by its canonical hash; full input revisions are available in run detail and paginated report revision references. Null manifestHash means binding did not complete and never permits simulation. Costs/parameters/folds are explicit in protocol; fill/rounding/warm-up rules are bound by manifest and assumptions.

BacktestReliabilityFinding.description: Whitelist-only finding, without provider payload/free-text diagnostics. Current revocations/corrections are reported separately from this immutable finding.

BacktestReliabilityReportV1.description: REQ-RRB-008/009/010/011/012; T-RRB-013..020. Immutable report overview repeated on every report page; qualitative independent dimensions never form a score or certify Strict PIT. Findings and revision references are separately paginated. UNKNOWN corporate actions never means NO_ACTIONS; raw-discontinuity-v1 >=20 percent is a blocker, not proof of action freedom. Semantic checks enforce matching fold/protocol/snapshot/manifest bindings and block incomplete budgets.

BacktestReliabilityReportPage.description: Immutable overview on every page. limit 1..200 applies to selected section. Empty terminal pages use null cursor; cursor binds report/hash/version/filter. Current warnings are mutable read-time facts excluded from historical report hash; trust port failure never becomes a positive warning-free execution permission.

BacktestAssessment.description: REQ-RRB-001/002/005/008/012; T-RRB-002/008/009/011/013/020. Durable preview only, never starts simulation. assessmentHash binds exact normalized protocol/snapshot/report. SUCCEEDED means completed eligible exploration, never Strict ELIGIBLE; current trust and exact binding are rechecked when run is explicitly created.

BacktestRetrospectiveCoverage.description: Retrospective successful bar completeness is independent of corporate-action evidence. UNKNOWN never asserts certified action absence; historical local availability is unproven.

simulatedMarketCutoff.description: Simulated market-event boundary only. This is not a historical local receipt or provider publication claim; actual observed/available/ingested times remain in the bound manifest.
